feeds.title: Kelly in the City
feeds.description: Kelly in the City is a Preppy Chicago Life, Style, and Fashion Blog. My name is Kelly Larkin, and this blog is where I document my life. You'll find a whole lot of fashion- and home-related content on Kelly in the City.

feeds.title: Mom and More
feeds.description: Covers parenting, app reviews, book reviews, art and craft, deals, events, recipes, finance management, travel, and more. Cher Kachelmuss is a 30-something-year-old stay-at-home mom with a 13-year-old boy, a 12-year-old boy, and a 9-year-old girl.

feeds.title: Gold Coast Girl Blog
feeds.description: My name is Samantha and this is my personal fashion + lifestyle guide. I created this blog as a creative outlet for me to express my love for all things related to fashion, food, fitness, home decor, beauty, and more recently motherhood.

feeds.title: Chiil Mama
feeds.description: Bonnie Kenaz-Mara is a freelance writer, videographer, photographer with a P.R./Marketing & Theatre Arts degree from Miami University. She blogs about Chicago based adult & children's theatre, multicultural events, and live concerts, but also cover eco-friendly living, fashion, food, and fun.

feeds.title: Baby Sideburns
feeds.description: Focuses on parenting, motherhood, healthy recipes, travel, and more.Karen Alpert is the author behind the blog Baby Sideburns.

feeds.title: The Windy City Mama
feeds.description: I am Jessica Roe - wife, mother, and lifestyle blogger. Come along as I talk about all things from sales to recipes, motherhood to fashion trends. I hope this blog helps to inspire other young parents!

feeds.title: Making Time for Mommy
feeds.description: I'm Alicia, the author of this blog, and I love sharing bits of our life here. I hope this blog encourages you to make time for yourself, gives you ideas for family fun, and provides easy tips you can incorporate into your busy life!

feeds.title: Frosted Fingers
feeds.description: My name is Paula, I'm a 41 year old mom of six homeschooled kids. I love to cook and bake and bring those adventures to this blog.

feeds.title: Tiaras & Tantrums Blog
feeds.description: Tiaras & Tantrums is the creative outlet for Chicago Lifestyle Blogger, Rese, who shares tips on family, parenting, travel, home educating, local Chicago activities, recipes, and much more.

feeds.title: A Glass of Goldwater
feeds.description: Alyssa Goldwater is a CEO, wife, mom, and the creative mastermind behind the lifestyle brand, A Glass of Goldwater. Merging motherhood with humor and witty reality, A Glass of Goldwater has become a community and support network for women across the world.

feeds.title: West of the Loop
feeds.description: I am Emily. An Ivy League-educated lawyer turned food writer, I bring passion, a sharp intellect, and attention to detail to my globally-inspired Jewish and Mediterranean cuisine. Find scratch cooking for weeknight dinners and special occasions; DIY kitchen projects and restaurant reviews.

feeds.title: All Dressed Up
feeds.description: Cheryl Leahy is a Millenial Mom living on the North Shore of Chicago. All Dressed Up is a lifestyle blog about fashion, style, beauty, food, entertaining, parenting, and what it takes to keep a sense of self while adapting to motherhood.

feeds.title: Helen Berkun Blog
feeds.description: Helen Berkun is a creative director, photographer, fashion stylist, and influencer currently residing in Chicago. This multi-talented girl lives, eats, sleeps, and breathes fashion.

feeds.title: LalyMom
feeds.description: I'm Laura, a Chicago Area mom to two sweet redheads! My daughter was born in 2010 and my son in 2012. I love to blog about creative kids crafts and activities as well as the occasional parenting piece.

feeds.title: Jillian Horn
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Jillian Horn, the owner of the blog. I started this adventure as more of a journal for my family's travels and it grew from there.

feeds.title: The Glam Mom
feeds.description: Michelle is a mom to 3 awesome kids living in Chicago. She decided to start this blog as an outlet for all the things she loves in life - her family, Makeup, Hair, and fashion.

feeds.title: Katie Cassman
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Katie. Mom to Caroline and wife to Kevin, living in Chicago's North Shore. I love sharing my motherhood journey, real estate career and favorite spots in the city & suburbs. Along with snapshots of my life & style. I have an affinity for glossy magazines, rose, and slight online shopping addiction.

feeds.title: Second City Mom
feeds.description: My name is Leyla. I am a Chicago mom and lifestyle blogger exploring the Second City (and sometimes the world - see our travels) with my family. Finding and sharing the hidden gems in Chicago as a family and making memories along the way.

feeds.title: Chefdruck
feeds.description: Vanessa Druckman is a French foodie mom blogger living in Chicago. She has been writing her food, family and travel lifestyle blog for over six years.

feeds.title: Making it Lovely
feeds.description: Making it Lovely by Nicole Balch, is a design and lifestyle blog about living a stylish life and transforming the so-so.

feeds.title: Happily Ever Natural
feeds.description: Michelle is a wife, mom, lifestyle content creator + Social Media Strategist from Chicago, IL. On this blog, you will find all things lifestyle, beauty, mom life, travel and so much more.

feeds.title: Momma Cuisine Blog
feeds.description: National cooking personality and host, Johanna Marie has been captivating audiences with Momma Cuisine since 2009. Momma Cuisine is about making great everyday meals simply, affordably, and elegantly made with simple ingredients and basic cooking techniques.

feeds.title: My Thoughts, Ideas, and Ramblings
feeds.description: This blog is run by work at home mom Lisa, who lives in the Chicago area with her husband and two children, ages 8 and 5. She started blogging to keep in touch with long-distance family and friends. After experiencing some personal issues in July of the same year, she learned she could help others with her experiences through blogging.
